description: Java class 'AdvancedPaymentAllocationsJsonParser' responsible for parsing JSON data related to loan product payment allocations in the Fineract project.

classes.name: AdvancedPaymentAllocationsJsonParser
classes.description: Service class for parsing JSON related to advanced payment allocations in loan products.

methods.name: assembleLoanProductPaymentAllocationRules
methods.description: Parses JSON command to assemble a list of loan product payment allocation rules, validating them afterward.

methods.name: populatePaymentAllocationRules
methods.description: Populates payment allocation types into a rule object based on JSON data.

methods.name: populateFutureInstallment
methods.description: Sets future installment allocation rule from JSON data into the rule object.

methods.name: populateTransactionType
methods.description: Sets transaction type from JSON data into the rule object.

methods.name: getPaymentAllocationTypes
methods.description: Extracts and sorts payment allocation types from JSON array.

methods.name: asIntegerOrNull
methods.description: Converts JSON element to Integer or null.

methods.name: asStringOrNull
methods.description: Converts JSON element to String or null.

methods.name: asJsonArrayOrNull
methods.description: Converts JSON element to JsonArray or null.
